{"search_note":"I searched directly for 2024 evidence on cyber, biological, AI, and other catastrophic-risk domains.
I found no credible 2024 source showing Abiy’s government published transparent safeguards, formal precautionary frameworks, or independent oversight in those specific areas.
I also found no direct evidence of a major cyber/bio/AI catastrophe-risk initiative, positive or negative, in the 2024 record I reviewed.
So the assessment is mostly indirect, based on disaster governance, peaceful nuclear cooperation, and the degree of openness in security structures.","evidence":[{"title":"Commission Revamping Disaster Response Works to Address Humanitarian Needs","publisher":"ENA English","date":"2024-04-26","url":"https://www.ena.et/web/eng/w/eng_4358046","summary":"Ethiopia’s Disaster Risk Management Commission said it was overhauling structure, policy, staffing, and technology to improve emergency management and response capacity. This is the strongest positive evidence of precautionary institution-building in a catastrophe-relevant domain.","question_ids":["1B.9","1B.3","1B.7"]},{"title":"Officials said the newly ratified disaster-risk policy would help Ethiopia mitigate and respond to natural and manmade calamities using its own resources, with a new structure for the commission.","publisher":"ENA English","date":"2024-07-05","url":"https://www.ena.et/web/eng/w/eng_4724392","summary":"The government framed the new disaster-risk policy as a way to build prevention and response capacity inside state institutions. That is consistent with precaution, though not with strong transparency.","question_ids":["1B.9","1B.3","1B.7"]},{"title":"Council Vows to Strengthen Disaster Emergency Response Activities in Ethiopia","publisher":"ENA English","date":"2024-08-17","url":"https://www.ena.et/web/eng/w/eng_4989768","summary":"The disaster-risk council called for a more effective emergency-preparedness system and stronger prevention and information-sharing after deadly landslides and floods. This supports general safety culture and accident-prevention capacity.","question_ids":["1B.9","1B.3","1B.7"]},{"title":"Discussion Held with CNNC on Potential Collaboration in Nuclear Energy in Ethiopia","publisher":"ENA English","date":"2024-07-01","url":"https://www.ena.et/web/eng/w/eng_4693757","summary":"Ethiopian officials discussed peaceful nuclear cooperation with CNNC, including infrastructure development and human-resource training for a future nuclear program. This is the clearest 2024 evidence of handling a dual-use-adjacent domain through civilian capacity-building, not secrecy or militarized signaling.","question_ids":["1B.9","1B.7","1B.5","1B.4"]},{"title":"Ethiopia to Chair AFRA for One Year","publisher":"ENA English","date":"2024-09-21","url":"https://www.ena.et/web/eng/w/eng_5179100","summary":"Ethiopia took over chairmanship of AFRA, an intergovernmental framework promoting peaceful nuclear science and technology in Africa. This is positive evidence of engagement with an expert, civilian nuclear institution.","question_ids":["1B.9","1B.7","1B.4","1B.5"]},{"title":"Special report - In Ethiopia, secret committee ‘orders killings and arrests to crush rebels’","publisher":"Times LIVE, reporting Reuters investigation","date":"2024-02-23","url":"https://www.timeslive.co.za/news/africa/2024-02-23-special-report-in-ethiopia-secret-committee-orders-killings-and-arrests-to-crush-rebels/","summary":"Reuters reported a secretive security committee in Oromia allegedly directing killings and arrests. This is negative evidence for transparency and precaution: a covert, politically aligned structure is the opposite of open risk governance.","question_ids":["1B.9","1B.7","1B.8"]},{"title":"Details of State of Emergency Declared by Gov't of Ethiopia","publisher":"ENA English","date":"2024-11-03","url":"https://www.ena.et/web/eng/w/en_30124","summary":"The proclamation centralized coercive authority and authorized an operation command to issue directives. This suggests control through emergency powers rather than transparent, expert-led risk management.","question_ids":["1B.9","1B.7","1B.8"]},{"title":"Ethiopia: Halt Crackdown Against Human Rights Groups","publisher":"Human Rights Watch","date":"2024-06-18","url":"https://www.hrw.org/news/2024/06/18/ethiopia-halt-crackdown-against-human-rights-groups","summary":"HRW said security and intelligence personnel followed, intimidated, and threatened human-rights workers. That is negative evidence for transparent handling of sensitive risk domains.","question_ids":["1B.9","1B.7"]}]}
